infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Red Anchor Sentinel requires microphone access to capture ambient sound levels (in decibels) for the environmental safety radar. Audio is processed locally and never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Red Anchor Sentinel requires camera access to scan the QR code displayed on your desktop host for secure LAN pairing.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app requires local network access to discover and securely pair with the Red Anchor desktop host running on your same Wi-Fi.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Red Anchor Sentinel uses Face ID to unlock the account session stored in this device's keychain. The session stays on the phone and is not uploaded.
